//: Merge into <project>/.claude/settings.json. install.sh does this for you.
//permissions: Without these, every simulator command stops on a prompt and a reader assumes
something is misconfigured. The shape is deliberate:
- this workflow's own scripts, by path prefix;
- serve-sim's READ-ONLY verbs only. --list is allowed; --kill is NOT, because
a bare `serve-sim --kill` takes down every other session's mirror and an
allowlist entry cannot tell a scoped kill from an unscoped one;
- read-only simctl verbs, plus boot/launch/install/terminate which the
workflow needs. `erase` is deliberately absent: it destroys another
Entries are matched against the command as typed, so they only fire when the
command uses that exact relative path from the project root.
//hooks: OPTIONAL. Seats the simulator on the canvas the first time a session touches
one, without being asked. The matcher must be the literal string "Bash" —
not a regex, not "*" — because that is what gives the hook the Bash
tool_input shape it parses. $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is a hook-time substitution,
not a shell variable (it is unset inside a Bash tool call), which is what
lets the wiring survive the project folder moving.
Delete this block if you would rather seat devices explicitly.
